education.instructions: Which school team should handle this message? Choose its primary purpose.

criteria.admissions: applications, eligibility, acceptance, enrollment or transfer into the school
criteria.coursework: classes, assignments, grades, exams, curriculum or academic progress
criteria.fees_aid: tuition charges, payments, scholarships or financial aid
criteria.technology: school accounts, login, learning platform, software or device access
criteria.student_support: counseling, accessibility, housing or general student wellbeing

healthcare.instructions: Which healthcare service team should route this patient message to? This is message routing, not medical triage or diagnosis.

criteria.appointments: booking, changing or canceling visits and scheduling logistics
criteria.billing_insurance: charges, invoices, insurance coverage or claim processing
criteria.records: copies of medical records, test reports, chart corrections or record access
criteria.prescriptions: refills, pharmacy transfers or medication order processing
criteria.care_team: questions about symptoms, treatment, recovery or a clinician's care instructions

mining.instructions: Which mine operations team should handle this report? Choose its primary purpose.

criteria.safety: worker hazards, incidents, protective controls or unsafe conditions
criteria.equipment: repair, servicing, failure or maintenance of mine machinery
criteria.geology: ore samples, drilling results, grade estimates or deposit interpretation
criteria.logistics: ore hauling, supplies, transport, stockpiles or dispatch
criteria.environment: water, dust, emissions, waste, rehabilitation or environmental monitoring

agriculture.instructions: Which farm operations team should handle this message? Choose its primary purpose.

criteria.crops: plant growth, pests, disease, soil nutrients or field agronomy
criteria.irrigation: watering schedules, pumps, water pressure or irrigation lines
criteria.machinery: repair, maintenance or operation of tractors and farm equipment
criteria.logistics: harvest transport, storage, packing, delivery or inventory movement
criteria.farm_finance: input costs, invoices, farm credit, insurance or payments

banking.instructions: Which bank support team should handle this customer message? Choose its primary purpose.

criteria.accounts: opening, closing, statements, balances or access to deposit accounts
criteria.payments: transfers, direct deposits, bill payments or payment status
criteria.cards: debit or credit card delivery, limits, replacement or use
criteria.loans: loan applications, installments, payoff or borrowing terms
criteria.security: suspected fraud, unauthorized access, phishing or account protection
